title: Keep helpers on pi and stop the open-input hang
about: Helpers stay on pi, always start with their input closed, and use a pinned version. Codex CLI is set up as a tested backup.

understood.label: You asked
understood.text: Apply the engine pick: keep helper jobs reliable on pi, with a backup ready.

understood.label: Done when
understood.text: 100 helper runs finish with no hang, and one backup run on Codex passes the same job.

understood.label: Facts as of
understood.text: 21 Oct 2026, from the engine report on this board.

visual.heading: Three steps make pi safe now and keep a way out
visual.text: Each step lands and is proven before the next one starts.

rows.label: Close the input
rows.text: Start every pi helper with its input closed.

rows.label: Pin the version
rows.text: Use one tested pi version; update only on purpose.

rows.label: Ready the backup
rows.text: Run the same helper job once on Codex CLI.

sections.heading: The pick rests on 12 engines and outside proof
sections.body: The engine report surveyed 12 engines, short-listed 4 on the same 5 points and linked each claim.

items.title: Options weighed
items.text: pi, Codex CLI, OpenCode and Goose.
items.more: pi: any model and small, but hangs on an open input (github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10415). Codex: mature scripted mode, but other models are a side path (github.com/openai/codex/issues/26234). OpenCode: forced major upgrade and a key leak on 17 Oct (news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50133401). Goose: hooks skip scripted mode (github.com/aaif-goose/goose/issues/12746).

items.title: Checked by me
items.text: pi 1.0.0 hung with its input open; closing it is the fix.
items.more: Run on 21 Oct 2026 with a 6-second limit; the limit stopped it.

sections.heading: Scope: how helpers start, not what they do
sections.body: In: the helper launch command, the pinned version and one backup route. Out: main workers, models and prompts.

items.title: In scope
items.text: Launch command, version pin, backup route, a 100-run check.

items.title: Out of scope
items.text: Main workers on Claude Code, model choice, OpenCode 2 trials.
items.more: OpenCode 2 is looked at again on 21 Nov 2026, with the same 5 points.

sections.heading: Three steps, each proven before the next
sections.body: Each step is small and can be undone by one change.

items.title: 1. Close the input
items.text: Start pi with nothing waiting on its input.
items.more: Proof: the open-input test that hung now ends in under 1 second.

items.title: 2. Pin the version
items.text: Use one tested pi version for every helper.
items.more: Proof: every helper log names the same version for one week.

items.title: 3. Ready the backup
items.text: Run one helper job on Codex CLI.
items.more: Proof: the same job gives the same result; turn off its background service first.

sections.heading: Three risks, each with a counter

items.title: pi changes model silently
items.text: Counter: name the model on every helper run.
items.more: Reported in github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10623; a named model avoids the stale default.

items.title: A pinned version misses fixes
items.text: Counter: read pi change notes each week.

items.title: Codex adds a background service
items.text: Counter: turn it off for the backup run.

decisions.question: Pin pi to one tested version?
decisions.why: Updates arrive weekly and one changed the model in use.

options.label: A: Pin and update on purpose
options.outcome: Helpers stay stable; I read notes weekly.

options.label: B: Follow each release
options.outcome: Fixes land at once, with surprise changes.

decisions.reason: A surprise model change costs more than a week's delay on a fix.
decisions.quiet: I pin the current tested version.

decisions.question: Set up Codex CLI as the backup now?
decisions.why: If pi's hang returns, helpers stop with no way out.

options.label: A: Yes, one tested run now
options.outcome: A proven backup in about an hour.

options.label: B: Only if pi fails
options.outcome: No work now, but a slow switch later.

decisions.reason: One hour now buys a same-day switch later.
decisions.quiet: I set up the backup with one run.
